route_title: Eight-Layer Thick-Subset Perturbation with Damped Learning
compilation_rationale: Fixed 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack with provided initial thicknesses. Optimized exactly the eight specified 120 nm layers while fixing the remaining sixteen. Coherent TMM evaluates 200-1500 nm at normal incidence. Uncertainty models ±15 nm absolute deviation for robustness scoring.
